risks.risk: Whether it actually prints/copies reliably (paper feed, scanning, fuser/heat, and no error codes).
risks.proof: A short video of a full copy/print cycle (e.g., copy a page, then show the output) plus a close-up of any status/error screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven/possibly needing service (worst case: treat as not fully functional until tested).

risks.risk: Toner/consumables condition (low/empty toner, drum/OPC wear) affecting print quality and cost to restore.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the toner/drum area (or toner cartridge label) and a sample output showing print quality (text + solid areas).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming consumables may be low/near end-of-life (worst case: budget for replacement).

risks.risk: Paper handling issues (tray alignment, rollers, misfeeds) not visible in static photos.
risks.proof: Video showing feeding from the main tray and successful multi-page copy (e.g., 5–10 pages).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming possible paper-feed faults (worst case: may require parts/adjustment).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (power cable, USB/network cable, document feeder parts, output tray components).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out + close-up of rear ports and confirmation of included cables.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming only the unit is included (worst case: buyer may need to source missing cables/parts).

risks.risk: Model mismatch (AR-M201 vs similar Sharp models) due to partially obscured model text.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model/serial label (rear or inside door) with the text fully readable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest value among likely close variants until the exact label is confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the model/serial label (rear or inside) with text fully readable.
Send a short video of copying/printing at least 5 pages, showing the output and any status/error indicators.
Send a clear photo of the toner/drum/consumables area (and what cartridge is installed).
Send photos of the rear ports and confirm what cables/accessories are included.
response.reason: The photos suggest a Sharp AR-M201 copier, but key value drivers (true functionality, consumables condition, and paper-feed reliability) are not proven by the images. Without a test output, pricing would be guesswork.
